transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get the wrap disposition plan locked today. As we all know, the set is scheduled for dismantling on Friday after the final stage shoot, and the current draft plan sends scenic pieces to a general salvage vendor with selected hero props going to production storage. Before I can approve the plan, I need each department lead to confirm the exact disposition and environmental-compliance requirements for their department. If anyone has an exception to the draft, please state the exact corrective requirement now so it can be entered into the meeting record. Let's go through department by department.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception to the draft plan. The antique jukebox, which is listed as a hero prop slated for production storage, is actually a rented piece. I confirmed with the rental house yesterday that its agreement requires it to be returned to the owner in its original condition — it cannot go into storage or salvage. The corrective requirement is: remove the antique jukebox from the production storage disposition and instead schedule it for return to the rental house owner in its original condition, in compliance with the rental agreement. This is a Property Department exception and I, Derek, take responsibility for this corrective action.

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception to the draft plan on the Sustainability side. The city green-film incentive requires at least 85 percent of dismantled set material by weight to be diverted from landfill. The approved vendor's audited plan reaches that threshold only through separate wood and metal recycling bins plus a certified transfer record. I confirmed the plan with the vendor this morning, but the compliance packet still contains the general-salvage draft. The corrective requirement is: replace the general-salvage vendor disposition for scenic pieces with the audited wood-and-metal recycling plan including separate bins and a certified transfer record, and update the compliance packet accordingly so we meet the 85 percent landfill diversion threshold. This is a Sustainability Department exception and I, Lina, take responsibility for this corrective action.
